signal: Nextech launched Cora Scribe, an AI clinical assistant for ophthalmology, in January 2026, on top of its new med spa platform and CRM previews.

email.body1:
Dominique, saw Nextech just launched Cora Scribe and is previewing new CRM tech for specialty practices.

Shipping new product lines that fast usually means more in-market accounts than an inside sales team can cover before momentum cools, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Nextech off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dominique, quick follow-up for Nextech.

When new launches expand the addressable market, reps end up rationing research time instead of selling, and the best-fit specialty accounts get a generic touch. Tightening emails to 75-100 words alone tends to lift responses about 67%, and most teams never get there at scale.

I had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to your top 3 target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body3:
Dominique, last bit of proof for Nextech.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nextech's reply rate likely compares to other healthcare software teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dominique, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding inside reps isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a product push, coverage rarely gets the attention it needs, and I get that timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your inside sales motion? I'll tailor it to Nextech either way.
